# SD13-E2-F3a Half-Elf bounded race-semantics fixture.
#
# This fixture is **recognition-only**. Half-Elf is named as a chosen race on the
# deterministic pilot seam so that a Half-Elf character input parses without
# validation failure and the receipt carries a single explicit, non-claim-blocking
# `race.half_elf.bounded_semantics` diagnostic. The fixture does not exercise any
# Half-Elf racial mechanic: no Half-Elf ability-bonus choice is selected (so no
# `race.half_elf.ability_bonus_target` analog is emitted), no Half-Elf sleep-immunity
# or low-light-vision assertion is required (those traits live outside the bounded
# compute seam in this slice), and no Half-Elf multiclass / favored-class engine
# is exercised. The chosen human-style Fighter pilot chassis anchors the rest of the
# fixture so the bounded pilot surface continues to behave identically when the
# `race_id` swap is the only change.
#
# Acceptance of chosen input is the bounded surface; computed Half-Elf mechanics
# are deliberately not asserted here. See
# programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/race-bounded-semantics/half-elf-bounded-semantics.md
# for the full bounded scope statement.

class_level=class:fighter:1
